name: io.github.Joshuv-AI/tower-of-babel
title: Tower of Babel
description: Search and read 2.5M+ public-domain full texts from the Tower of Babel library. No key required.

tools.name: search_works
tools.description: Search the Tower of Babel public-domain library by title or creator. Results are in catalog order, not relevance-ranked; follow next_cursor until it is null to cover more of the catalog. Read-only.

query.description: Search text, matched as words against title and/or creator.

field.description: Which field the search text is matched against: title only, author (creator) only, or any (both). Defaults to any.

limit.description: Maximum number of works to return in this page (1-50). Defaults to 20.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor from a previous call.

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: Get one work's metadata by its id (artifact id, e.g. us-declaration-of-independence). Read-only.

tools.name: list_collection
tools.description: List works in one collection (PAPERS, DECLASSIFIED, BOOKS, REFERENCE, DOCUMENTS, PODCASTS) in catalog order. Follow next_cursor until null. Read-only.

collection.description: The collection to list: PAPERS, DECLASSIFIED, LAW, BOOKS, REFERENCE, DOCUMENTS, or PODCASTS.

limit.description: Maximum number of works to return in this page (1-50). Defaults to 20.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor from a previous call.

tools.name: list_group
tools.description: List works in a precomputed group: a sacred tradition, a declassified programme, a top author, or a course group. Use the collections endpoint (or the library's group lists) for valid keys. Read-only.

group.description: The kind of group to list: traditions (sacred traditions), programmes (declassified programmes), authors (top authors), or course (course groups).

key.description: Tradition/programme key, author slug, or course-group slug.

limit.description: Maximum number of works to return in this page (1-50). Defaults to 20.

offset.description: Number of works to skip before returning results, for paging through a group. Defaults to 0.
